facts.fact: Modern Ghana reports that 663,226 births were registered in 2023, a 90.8% registration rate (92.3% in 2022), though it fell to 73.4% of expected coverage by end-2025.
The Eastern Region Registrar says officers are expected to complete digital registrations in communities, and an Assembly Member says birth registration 'has been digitalised'.
